summary: Defines Q-Block1 and Q-Block2, alternative CoAP block-wise transfer options that complement the Block1 and Block2 options of RFC 7959. They support sending large data using Non-confirmable messages with fewer packet exchanges and allow faster recovery when blocks are lost.

eli5.summary: A big file is sent in small pieces without waiting for a reply after each one, and only missing pieces get resent.

questions: send large payloads over coap non-confirmable
